div.head: ECf 16.2
div.ab: ita quod, si quis de Anglis aliquem ipsorum interficeret, si non posset defendere se iudicio Dei, ferro uel aqua, fieret iusticia de eo; si autem aufugeret, solueretur, ut supra dictum est.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 642 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

seg.hi: des Thäters Nationalität stand nach Bisherigem nicht in Frage

note.seg: from what has gone before, the slayer’s nationality was not in question
das Ordal reinigt vom Verdacht des heimlichen Todtschlags (nicht des offenen zur Abwehr oder Rache, dem Widerrechtlichkeit vorgeworfen)
the ordeal clears of the suspicion of secret homicide (not of open homicide in self-defence or revenge, of which unlawfulness is alleged)
Itaque si Rl S Ad Do
Itaque si Rl S Ad Do
scilicet fügt zu Hr Ad Do

div.ab: so that, if any of the English killed any of them, if he could not defend himself by the judgment of God, by iron or water, justice should be done on him; but if he fled, payment should be made, as is said above.

note.seg: S. zu o. 15. — Vgl. Gl Mord 6e; Ordal 23a. Es ist Reinigung vom Verdachte des Murdrum, nicht Erweis der berechtigten Notwehr oder der Selbsthilfe gegen Verbrecher, welche Fälle der Totschläger selbst hätte melden müssen. — 20interf. si ohne et — 26 folgt 13, 1 Rs

See on 15 above. — Cf. Gl Mord 6e; Ordal 23a. It is purgation from the suspicion of murdrum, not proof of justified self-defence or of self-help against criminals, cases which the slayer would have had to report himself. — 20interf. si without et — after 26 follows 13, 1 in Rs
